issues.issue: Only receipt line, 100% of receipts in 'other'. The waiver form gives no breakdown; for an irrigation district this is most likely irrigation assessments/water charges. Defensible as printed, already marked review.
Irrigation district assigned 'utilities'. The disbursement rules put water and drainage districts under 'natural resources/conservation', which may fit better. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Total of All Funds (no fund type shown)

Fiscal year end is assumed, not printed; irrigation districts often use a calendar year (2025-12-31 or 2024-12-31). Notes say it was assumed.
